sentences.text:
THIS APPEAL, COMING ON FOR ORDERS, THIS DAY, THE COURT DELIVERED THE FOLLOWING:
 JUDGMENT
Matter is listed for orders regarding non-compliance of office objections for 4th time.
Though sufficient time was granted for compliance of office objections, they are not yet complied.
Even till date, office objections are not complied, which would indicate that appellant is not diligent in prosecuting appeal.
Hence, appeal is dismissed for non-prosecution.
